decisions.reason: As a design variant very close to the firm's core drainage know-how, backed by in-house R&D and still given its own page in 2024, it is easy for the firm to understand, improve, and sell within its established customer base.

This shower channel is tightly related to the firm's established drainage systems and strategic focus on modern seamless bathrooms, so the firm has strong absorptive capacity to refine it and little reason to withdraw it after two years of continued website presence.

Although the pump-drain concept is more complex and a related pump-assisted product disappeared earlier, it still builds on the firm's drainage knowledge and R&D base, so management is more likely to keep developing it than to remove it immediately.
